title: CEFR Multilevel Mock - Writing - Variant B

parts.title: Part 1
parts.instructions:
Read the situation below and answer BOTH Task 1.1 and Task 1.2. Write your answers on the answer sheet.

You received a message from the manager of your study centre.

Dear Student,

From the first of next month the Silk Road Study Centre is planning two changes. First, we will stop printing paper workbooks: every student will be asked to buy a tablet and read all course materials on screen. Second, our evening classes on Tuesday and Thursday will no longer take place in the building; they will be taught online instead.

We would like to hear from you before we make the final decision.

Dilnoza Rahimova
The Centre Manager

questions.q:
1  WRITING TASK 1.1

You received a message from the manager of your study centre.

Dear Student,

From the first of next month the Silk Road Study Centre is planning two changes. First, we will stop printing paper workbooks: every student will be asked to buy a tablet and read all course materials on screen. Second, our evening classes on Tuesday and Thursday will no longer take place in the building; they will be taught online instead.

We would like to hear from you before we make the final decision.

Dilnoza Rahimova
The Centre Manager

Write a short letter to your friend who also studies at this centre with you. Explain the situation about the possible changes and tell them how you feel about it.

Write about 50 words.
questions.topic: Writing - Informal letter to a friend

parts.title: Part 2
parts.instructions: Read the task below and write your answer on the answer sheet.

questions.q:
3  WRITING PART 2

You are participating in an online discussion for learners.

The question is: Some people say that technology in the classroom, such as tablets, videos and translation apps, helps students learn faster, while others believe it stops young people from thinking for themselves. What is your opinion?

Post your response, giving reasons and examples. Write 180-200 words.
